name: Inda no Himekishi Janne 2 ~Biki Tensei~ Futatsu no Sekai de Ogre no Kodane o Sosogare Tsuzukeru Monogatari~
original_name: 淫堕の姫騎士ジャンヌ2～美姫転生～ 2つの世界でオーガの仔種を注がれ続ける物語～
source:
Reincarnated Janne has been living in modern society peacefully as a normal student. However, when the original fantasy world Rib Foul was in danger, Janne was summoned as a savior to fight with the Ogre king Gidou.

[Translated and edited from [url=http://catwalk.product.co.jp/nero/products/cn07/story.html]Official site[/url]]
translation:
转世后的珍妮一直作为普通学生在现代社会平静地生活着。然而，当原本的幻想世界利布·福尔陷入危机时，珍妮被召唤为救世主，与食人魔王吉堂战斗。

[翻译并编辑自[url=http://catwalk.product.co.jp/nero/products/cn07/story.html]官网[/url]]
